answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 32005 Country: Pakistan Title: What are the conditions for offering Namaz e Eid?Can Namaz e Eid be offered in a village? Question: What are the conditions for offering Namaz e Eid?Can Namaz e Eid be offered in a village? Answer ID: 32005 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 813/L=292/tl=1432) It is necessary for the two Eid salah to be valid that the place where it is offered is a city, town or big village. The salah of Eid is not lawful in small village. تجب صلاتهما على من تجب عليه الجمعة بشرائطها المتقدمه سوی الخطبة فانها سنة بعدها وفى القنية: صلاة العيد فى القرى تكره تحريما (الدر المختار مع الشامى:3/45) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
